ISNVFilter: Quality control filter for iSNV analysis

Source: R/AllClasses.R, R/methods.R
ISNVFilter-class.Rd

An S4 class holding parameters for filtering intra-host single nucleotide variants. Used by flagISNV.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'ISNVFilter'
show(object)

Arguments

object

An ISNVFilter object.

Value

An object of class ISNVFilter. Objects are created with the constructor ISNVFilter; the show method prints the filter thresholds and returns NULL invisibly.

Details

Default values are based on commonly used thresholds in the within-host pathogen diversity literature:

minDepth = 100

Minimum coverage for variant detection. This is a permissive floor: Grubaugh et al. (2019, Genome Biology) measured iSNVs above 3% accurately from at least 1,000 RNA copies sequenced to at least 400x.

minFreq = 0.03

3% minor allele frequency threshold, the lower limit of accurate iSNV measurement in Grubaugh et al. (2019); Popa et al. (2020, Science Translational Medicine) used 2%.

maxFreq = 0.50

Variants above 50% are considered consensus-level changes, not intra-host variants.

minAltReads = 10

Minimum supporting reads to reduce false positives from sequencing errors.

maxStrandBias = 10

Maximum fold-difference between forward and reverse strand alt allele counts. Excessive strand bias suggests systematic error.

Slots

minDepth

Integer scalar. Minimum read depth at iSNV site (default: 100).

minFreq

Numeric scalar. Minimum alternative allele frequency (default: 0.03).

maxFreq

Numeric scalar. Maximum alternative allele frequency; variants above this are excluded as near-fixed (default: 0.50).

minAltReads

Integer scalar. Minimum reads supporting the alternative allele (default: 10).

maxStrandBias

Numeric scalar. Maximum strand bias as fold-difference between strands (default: 10.0).

replicateConc

A ConcordanceRule saying how technical replicates must agree, or NULL (default) for no replicate check. flagISNV applies it after the other thresholds.

References

Roder AE et al. (2023). Optimized quantification of intra-host viral diversity in SARS-CoV-2 and influenza virus sequence data. mBio 14:e01046-23. doi:10.1128/mbio.01046-23

McCrone JT, Lauring AS (2016). Measurements of intrahost viral diversity are extremely sensitive to systematic errors in variant calling. J Virol 90:6884-6895. doi:10.1128/JVI.00667-16

Grubaugh ND et al. (2019). An amplicon-based sequencing framework for accurately measuring intrahost virus diversity using PrimalSeq and iVar. Genome Biology 20:8. doi:10.1186/s13059-018-1618-7

Mostefai F et al. (2024). Refining SARS-CoV-2 intra-host variation by leveraging large-scale sequencing data. NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics 6:lqae145. doi:10.1093/nargab/lqae145

See also

ISNVFilter for the constructor, flagISNV for applying filters.

Examples

# Default filter
ISNVFilter()
#> ISNVFilter object
#>   minDepth:      100 
#>   freq range:   [0.03, 0.5]
#>   minAltReads:   10 
#>   maxStrandBias: 10 
#>   replicateConc: none

# Stringent filter
ISNVFilter(minDepth = 500L, minFreq = 0.05)
#> ISNVFilter object
#>   minDepth:      500 
#>   freq range:   [0.05, 0.5]
#>   minAltReads:   10 
#>   maxStrandBias: 10 
#>   replicateConc: none
